domain_criteria.criterion: Root cause vs. numerical duct-tape: does the design explain anomalies via a named physical mechanism (bearing spall, valve stiction, thermal runaway) rather than merely tripping a static threshold?
Does the architecture survive cascading noise, correlated sensor faults and false positives without unsafe actuation? Are low-confidence cases escalated?
LangGraph coupling vs. clear State Schemas: are detection, root-cause and action cleanly separated, with a deterministic safety gate that never evolves?
Are irreversible/physical actions gated behind HITL and a hard safety envelope? Reward-hacking a KPI by disabling sensors must be penalised heavily.
